lines.text: Eldwin! Eldwin, are you up? Come down and look at this!
Eldwin! Frost on the pumpkins and the fair's tonight.
If this is one of your 'old wall' things, fix it before the pie judging.

choice.text: I'll take a look at the walls.

lines.text: Silas is in a state about his press, too. Maybe start there. Then the orchard: Wren swears she saw lights.
The cider's frozen, you old goose. That's rather the problem.
Here. Two jugs from the cellar, warm from the stove. Now go on.
Still here? Then you can make yourself useful and take these off my hands. The fair won't miss two.
Walls, Eldwin. Pie judging. In that order, if you please.
Nearly lantern time. Don't you dare miss it.
You're grey as a dishrag, you old goose. Cold that gets in stays in.
Sit by a fire before you go anywhere you can't walk back from. And eat something while you're there.
Sit down, Eldwin, before you fall down. The walls will keep till morning.
You look like you wrestled a snowbank. Here. Cider. Hot.
Mister Eldwin! Did you see the frost lights? Did you catch one?
